purpose: One-time rehearsal setup, mapped so every release run knows what to create, where each secret comes from, what to clear and how everything is deleted. Names and sources only: this file never holds a secret value.
run_id_rule: First 7 characters of the candidate source commit, for example 9f67167.

storage.token_scope: Object Read and Write on the sqag-rehearsal bucket only. The deploy run confirms the final scope and region when it creates the token.
storage.clear_setup: Run on the server before each check or clear, because a redeploy replaces the container. It copies the reviewed script and map from the candidate's build folder, so it works even when the image under test predates the script: docker exec <rehearsal app container> mkdir -p /tmp/rehearsal-tools/scripts /tmp/rehearsal-tools/deploy/rehearsal && docker cp /root/sqag-build-<run id>/scripts/clear_rehearsal_bucket.py <rehearsal app container>:/tmp/rehearsal-tools/scripts/ && docker cp /root/sqag-build-<run id>/deploy/rehearsal/resources.json <rehearsal app container>:/tmp/rehearsal-tools/deploy/rehearsal/
storage.clear_command: docker exec <rehearsal app container> bash -lc 'python /tmp/rehearsal-tools/scripts/clear_rehearsal_bucket.py --expect-bucket sqag-rehearsal --mode clear'
storage.rule: The bucket is kept between runs and holds rehearsal files only. Each run checks it is empty before seeding and clears it before the app is deleted. No storage container or third-party storage image is used.

resources.name: quote-rehearsal
resources.created_by: Operator on the laptop, in Coolify: a Docker Compose service on the same server and project as live, compose pasted from deploy/rehearsal/compose.yaml. Every compose, variable or image change is applied with POST /api/v1/deploy?uuid=<service uuid>; a restart does not re-render the compose.
resources.delete: Clear the bucket first (storage.clear_setup, then storage.clear_command), then delete the quote-rehearsal service in Coolify with its containers.

resources.name: quote-rehearsal-copy
resources.created_by: Operator on the laptop, in Coolify, in step 8: a Docker Compose service on the same server and project as live, compose pasted from deploy/rehearsal/compose-live-copy.yaml, image the candidate. Variables as the rehearsal service, except the live_copy run values. Every change is applied with POST /api/v1/deploy?uuid=<service uuid>; a restart does not re-render the compose.
resources.delete: Kept up after Pass A for the agent's and then the owner's UAT on the copy (doc step 8), at most 24 hours unless the owner extends it. Delete it in Coolify with its containers in step 9, after the live deploy or when the owner abandons the candidate. Its files stay in the rehearsal bucket until step 9 empties it.

resources.name: sqag-rehearsal
resources.created_by: Owner-approved one-time setup: a Cloudflare R2 bucket used only by the rehearsal.
resources.clear: Each run: storage.clear_setup, then storage.clear_command with --mode check before seeding (clear first if a failed run left files), and with --mode clear before deleting the app.
resources.delete: Not deleted per run; its files are cleared. The owner removes the bucket when the rehearsal flow is retired.

resources.name: quote-rehearsal.<server-ip>.sslip.io
resources.created_by: Operator in Coolify: the service domain. Coolify services have no basic auth, so access control is the app's own sign-in with the run's test-only logins.

resources.name: rehearsal-<run id>
resources.branch_type: schema-only, parent is live's default branch
resources.created_by: Operator on the laptop with Neon access. Right after creating it, copy live's public.sqag_schema_migrations rows (sequence_no, migration_id, checksum_sha256, applied_at only) into the branch. A schema-only branch leaves the sqag_ tables and functions owned by neondb_owner, so on the branch only run GRANT sqag_migrator TO neondb_owner, ALTER ... OWNER TO sqag_migrator on each sqag_ table and function, then REVOKE sqag_migrator FROM neondb_owner. Then reset the passwords of the roles on the rehearsal-<run id> branch, named by its branch id, so no live password is used. Never reset a password on the default branch.
resources.delete: Delete the rehearsal-<run id> branch in the swooshz-sqag project. Never delete a branch whose name does not start with rehearsal-.

resources.name: rehearsal-copy-<run id>
resources.branch_type: with data, parent is live's default branch at a recorded time
resources.created_by: Operator on the laptop with Neon access, in step 8 before live switches: a branch of live's default branch WITH data at a recorded time (record it). Its rows, migration ledger and owners match live, so no ledger copy or owner change is needed. Then reset the passwords of the roles on the rehearsal-copy-<run id> branch, named by its branch id, so no live password is used. Never reset a password on the default branch. Apply the candidate's pending migrations on this branch only, as step 5 does on the rehearsal branch.
resources.delete: Delete the rehearsal-copy-<run id> branch in the swooshz-sqag project in step 9, with the copy service, after the live deploy or when the owner abandons the candidate. Never delete a branch whose name does not start with rehearsal-.

resources.name: rehearsal-run-secrets
resources.created_by: Generated on the laptop for one run and typed only into the rehearsal service's environment.
resources.delete: Removed with the Coolify service. The laptop copy lives only in the run's session and is dropped at the end.

resources.name: SWOOSHZ_SQAG_REHEARSAL_R2
resources.created_by: Owner-approved one-time setup: an R2 API token scoped to the sqag-rehearsal bucket, stored in the laptop credential store (toolkit-env) under the entry names listed here, with the account's R2 S3 endpoint URL.
resources.delete: Not deleted per run. The owner revokes the token when it is no longer wanted.

resources.name: OPENROUTER_SWOOSHZ_SQAG_API_KEY
resources.created_by: Owner decision: the rehearsal reuses live's OpenRouter key, already in the laptop credential store (toolkit-env) under this name. It is set on the rehearsal app for one run only and leaves with the app. --no-ai keeps reruns free.
resources.delete: Not deleted per run; it is live's key. It leaves the rehearsal when the app is deleted.

resources.name: SWOOSHZ_SQAG_LIVE_READONLY_LOGIN
resources.created_by: Owner, once: the operator's own live sign-in, stored in the laptop credential store (toolkit-env) under the entry names listed here. Only the live read-only check uses it, through toolkit env run, so agents never see the values.
resources.delete: Not deleted per run. The owner removes it with toolkit env when it is no longer wanted.

resources.name: SWOOSHZ_SQAG_LIVE_R2_READONLY
resources.created_by: Owner, once: an R2 API token with Object Read only on live's bucket, stored in the laptop credential store (toolkit-env) under the entry names listed here. Only scripts/copy_live_objects_to_rehearsal.py reads it, through toolkit env run, and the script refuses it if its access key id equals the rehearsal token's.
resources.delete: Not deleted per run. The owner revokes the token when it is no longer wanted.

resources.name: SWOOSHZ_SQAG_REHEARSAL_UAT_LOGIN_PASSWORD
resources.created_by: Generated on the laptop for one run straight into the credential store (toolkit-env), never shown in chat. It is the copy app's sign-in password for the owner's own email (live_copy.run_values), bound to the owner's user id on the copy only, never their live password. The owner reads it there for the UAT on the copy.
resources.delete: Removed with toolkit env in step 9, with the copy service.

resources.name: neon
resources.created_by: Owner, once: the laptop's existing Neon access.

run_values.SQAG_TRUSTED_PROXY_CIDRS: Derived at create time from the rehearsal service's own network, never a fixed value: after the first deploy, read the subnet of the service's own network (not the shared coolify network) with docker network inspect, set it and redeploy. One exact subnet, never a trust-all range.
run_values.REHEARSAL_IMAGE_ID: The image id from the build record: the current live image first, then the candidate.

generated_rules.SQAG_INTERNAL_LOGIN_PASSWORD: 24 random characters, different from the admin password.
generated_rules.SQAG_INTERNAL_ADMIN_LOGIN_PASSWORD: 24 random characters, different from the staff password.

image_retention: Keep the current live image, the previous live image and the candidate. Removing any other image or old container is a separate owner-approved server action.

production_guard.purpose: Every step that writes to the copy's database (role password reset, migrations, the live object copy, seed and verify on the copy) runs scripts/neon_branch_guard.py first. It refuses a database host whose endpoint is listed here, a branch that is Neon's default or does not start with branch_prefix, or a host it cannot place. Names and ids only.
production_guard.source: Evidence store record alpha1-retirement-record-20261106 (live's default branch and its compute). The first run confirms both ids are still live's before relying on them.

live_copy.purpose: Pass A of the live-data end-to-end test: the candidate image on a copy of live data, before live switches. Nothing is written to live.

run_values.SQAG_INTERNAL_WORKSPACE_ID: Read on the data branch: the one workspace_id in public.sqag_quote_sessions, an opaque id. The copied rows and files are filed under it.
run_values.SQAG_INTERNAL_ALLOWED_EMAILS: The owner's own sign-in email (SWOOSHZ_SQAG_LIVE_READONLY_LOGIN_EMAIL), set from the credential store, so the copy shows the owner's quotes and company profiles as live does.
run_values.SQAG_INTERNAL_IDENTITY_BINDINGS_JSON: [] when live has no identity binding for that email. If it has one, the owner supplies that one row; without it the walk fails with a not-owned quote, never a false pass.
run_values.SQAG_DATABASE_URL: The data branch's runtime URL after its password reset.
run_values.SQAG_INTERNAL_ADMIN_LOGIN_PASSWORD: SWOOSHZ_SQAG_REHEARSAL_UAT_LOGIN_PASSWORD, generated for this run (the generated rule), never live's password. Pass A and the agent UAT sign in with it as SQAG_REHEARSAL_LOGIN_PASSWORD; the owner reads it from the credential store for the owner UAT.
